001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.LastBolusStatusAbstractResponse;
007
008/**
009 * History log record Bolus Completed, opCode 20, size 26.
010 *
011 * <br>
012 *
013 * 
014 * <table border='1'>
015 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>20</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Bolus Completed"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_BOLUS_COMPLETED"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByAndroid</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
021 * </table>
022 */
023@HistoryLogProps(
024    opCode = 20,
025    displayName = "Bolus Completed",
026    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_COMPLETED",
027    usedByAndroid = true,
028    usedByTidepool = true
029)
030public class BolusCompletedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
031    
032    private int completionStatusId;
033    private int bolusId;
034    private float iob;
035    private float insulinDelivered;
036    private float insulinRequested;
037    
038    public BolusCompletedHistoryLog() {}
039    
040    public BolusCompletedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int completionStatusId, int bolusId, float iob, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRequested) {
041        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, completionStatusId, bolusId, iob, insulinDelivered, insulinRequested, 0);
042    }
043
044    public BolusCompletedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int completionStatusId, int bolusId, float iob, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRequested, int headerHighNibble) {
045        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, completionStatusId, bolusId, iob, insulinDelivered, insulinRequested, headerHighNibble);
046        this.pumpTimeSec = pumpTimeSec;
047        this.sequenceNum = sequenceNum;
048        this.completionStatusId = completionStatusId;
049        this.bolusId = bolusId;
050        this.iob = iob;
051        this.insulinDelivered = insulinDelivered;
052        this.insulinRequested = insulinRequested;
053        
054    }
055
056    public int typeId() {
057        return 20;
058    }
059
060    /**
061     * <table border="1">
062     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusCompletedHistoryLog:</caption>
063     * <tr><td><code>completionStatusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>iob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>insulinDelivered</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>insulinRequested</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
068     * </table>
069     */
070    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
071        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
072        this.cargo = raw;
073        parseBase(raw);
074        this.completionStatusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
075        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
076        this.iob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
077        this.insulinDelivered = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
078        this.insulinRequested = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
079        
080    }
081
082    
083    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int completionStatus, int bolusId, float iob, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRequested) {
084        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, completionStatus, bolusId, iob, insulinDelivered, insulinRequested, 0);
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * <table border="1">
089     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusCompletedHistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
090     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
091     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
094     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
097     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(completionStatus) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(completionStatus) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinDelivered) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinDelivered) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinDelivered) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinDelivered) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
111     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinRequested) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
112     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinRequested) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
113     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinRequested) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
114     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>toFloat(insulinRequested) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
115     * </table>
116     */
117    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int completionStatus, int bolusId, float iob, float insulinDelivered, float insulinRequested, int headerHighNibble) {
118        return Bytes.combine(
119            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(20, headerHighNibble),
120            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
121            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
122            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(completionStatus),
123            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
124            Bytes.toFloat(iob),
125            Bytes.toFloat(insulinDelivered),
126            Bytes.toFloat(insulinRequested));
127    }
128    
129    public int getCompletionStatusId() {
130        return completionStatusId;
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * @return whether the bolus was completed fully or stopped
135     */
136    public LastBolusStatusAbstractResponse.BolusStatus getCompletionStatus() {
137        return LastBolusStatusAbstractResponse.BolusStatus.fromId(completionStatusId);
138    }
139
140    /**
141     * @return the ID of the bolus
142     */
143    public int getBolusId() {
144        return bolusId;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * @return the insulin on board recorded with this log, in units (a float, not milliunits).
149     * It includes this bolus: it equalled the paired {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog#getIob()}
150     * plus {@link #getInsulinDelivered()} to within 0.1u in 1270/1305 boluses on 10 pumps
151     * (t:slim X2 and Mobi).
152     */
153    public float getIob() {
154        return iob;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * @return the amount of insulin delivered, in real units. Note that due to ieee float
159     * precision, even if the bolus was completed fully this may differ from the units requested
160     * by one unit in the last place; compare against {@link #getInsulinRequested()} with a
161     * tolerance of {@link HistoryLog#INSULIN_FLOAT_EPSILON} rather than testing float equality
162     */
163    public float getInsulinDelivered() {
164        return insulinDelivered;
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * @return the amount of insulin requested, in real units
169     */
170    public float getInsulinRequested() {
171        return insulinRequested;
172    }
173    
174}
